headline: PROBE — Nexperia (Oct 2025) with injected concentration_delta=0.20
summary: This probe copies the entities and timestamp of J-2025-10-nexperia but injects concentration_delta=0.20. It measures pipeline behaviour on an out-of-domain event whose only matched entity is a place (country_region:netherlands); it does not represent a belief about the real event's impact.
notes: This magnitude is not an estimate of this event's real impact; it is an injected value chosen to measure entity-match fanout from an out-of-domain place match. Pass J.1 §6 uses this probe to decide whether the Nexperia null result in Pass J came from correct model behaviour or from the authored zero magnitude — the two possibilities produce different findings and are separable only under an injected magnitude that suppresses the axis-authoring path. Do not re-author the axes on the real event (J-2025-10-nexperia) based on anything this probe reveals; the real event's honest axis reading is 0.0.
